_comment: Single source of truth for deploy params. PLTY is a UUPS-upgradeable proxy: name/symbol/supply set here at deploy, but after launch the owner can mint more, upgrade the logic, and update metadata. Set 'owner' to a multisig (Safe) for trust if possible.
name: Kamohashi
ownerNotes: owner = mint authority + upgrade authority. Recommended: move to a Safe multisig / Timelock after deploy; renounceOwnership() to freeze forever when done.
